text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off. While strolling aimlessly 
around a commercial complex.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard from Hishiama-kun, didn't you 
break curfew again recently?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Tch, I was running. Like I have time to 
worry about the clock.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Even so. Stop running in the pitch dark. 
In the dark, even the smallest misstep can 
lead to a serious accident, you know?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What would you do if you tripped and fell 
on a night path? Knowing you, you wouldn't 
even raise your voice to call for help, 
would you?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
There's hardly any foot traffic at night. 
Nobody might even notice you! That's why I 
keep saying I'm opposed to you running at 
night—

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Hey, wait, Brian! I'm not finished 
talking yet—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. I agree to eat out for once, 
and this is what I get. Nagging about 
every little thing from A to Z...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ? Those guys are—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... McQueen? Are you okay...? You look 
super sleepy though...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I am sorry! What an unsightly 
display desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Um, the truth is, last night I ended up 
getting absorbed in reading a training 
manual and stayed up far too late...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Then, should we reschedule for another 
day? It's a movie you said you really 
wanted to see, after all—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, you truly do not need to go that far, 
I am quite alright, Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Really? But... Ah, then I'll go buy 
something to help wake you up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, even though I said I am fine... 
Honestly, Ryan is such a worrier desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, you too, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Eh... Brian-san?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I see. You as well, Brian-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's tough on both of us.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It has been this way since we were little. 
But if I show even the slightest hint of 
being unwell, they turn pale with worry...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Same here.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Although, we do know it comes from 
caring deeply about us.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I heard you were injured?! Are you okay? 
Depending on the situation, we should head 
to the hospital right now—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's a mild sprain... They said it'll heal 
right away.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see... That's a relief. I'm so glad 
it wasn't serious...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
—Exactly! I know McQueen will be fine, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Same here. Out of old habit, I ended up 
meddling unnecessarily...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I know full well that I need to let go 
of babying my sister soon, and yet...
